mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (name, age, class_id) VALUES (#{name}, #{age}, #{classId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM student WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
SELECT * FROM student WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student WHERE name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
SELECT s.id AS id, s.name AS name, s.age AS age, s.class_id AS classId, sc.name AS className FROM student AS s LEFT JOIN student_class AS sc ON s.class_id = sc.id ORDER BY s.id
